leftEvidence.title: Horeb addressed to the present generation

points.label: Covenant setting
points.left: Covenant memory is made present to a later audience rather than confined to the first hearers.
points.right: The scene places covenant response after rescue from Egypt, before the covenant words are publicly ratified.

points.label: Parties, action, or promise
points.left: Moses · Israel · Horeb · Hear · learn · keep · Past covenant spoken as present identity
points.right: Israel · Moses · Sinai · Hear voice · keep covenant · Treasured possession · kingdom of priests · holy nation

payload.posture: Deuteronomy addresses a present generation through the Horeb covenant first narrated at Sinai.
payload.tension: The two sources materially share covenant language or memory, while their parties, setting, action, or literary purpose remain distinct.
payload.title: Horeb remembered / Sinai encountered
